acceptanceCriteria: A version-catalog change maps to the modules whose build scripts reference the changed aliases, or to all modules with a stated reason.
com.android.test modules yield a typed unit or an explicit typed frontier instead of kotlin:unknown.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). In beamfall-android and beamfall-android-ui, gradle/libs.versions.toml is UNOWNED (no build-config edge), and com.android.test modules (benchmark-*, baselineprofile-*) produce kotlin:unknown units.
title: affected/kotlin: model the Gradle version catalog and com.android.test modules
